tips.text: Run the Lvl 55-60, 65-70 and 75-80 bounties back to back so every run advances a missing part.
Do not park on the highest bounties; they pay the most standing but never drop a Qorvex part.
Grab the Voca medallions in every Albrecht's Laboratories mission; you need one Echo Voca for the final build anyway.
Bring Parallax's Orokin Eye air support, loot radar or a wide-range frame like Xaku to find Voca and break containers.
Bank Deep Archimedea and Netracells into Cavia standing; they cover much of the pity-shop cost.
Start the Cavia rank-ups early so the pity shop is open if your drops go cold.
Skip Mirror Defense for Voca; it is the one Albrecht's Laboratories mission that spawns none.
Take the highest bounty when it rolls Exterminate if you are grinding standing; other mission types pay the same far slower.
Players call Qorvex one of the easier frames, an evening or two of mixed-tier bounties.
Buying parts with standing turns the farm into a week of waiting on the daily cap, and players regret it.
